toolCalls.commandLine:
*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: src/routes/api.catalog.ts
+import { createFileRoute } from '@tanstack/react-router'
+import { getStorefront } from '~/data/db'
+
+export const Route = createFileRoute('/api/catalog')({
+  server: {
+    handlers: {
+      GET: async ({ request }) => {
+        const url = new URL(request.url)
+        return Response.json(getStorefront({
+          model: url.searchParams.get('model') ?? 'all',
+          category: url.searchParams.get('category') ?? 'all',
+          sort: (url.searchParams.get('sort') as 'featured' | 'newest' | 'popular' | null) ?? 'featured',
+          q: url.searchParams.get('q') ?? '',
+          favorites: url.searchParams.get('favorites') === 'true',
+          free: url.searchParams.get('free') === 'true',
+        }))
+      },
+    },
+  },
+})
*** End Patch

toolCalls.name: apply_patch
toolCalls.commandLine:
*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: src/routes/api.cart.ts
+import { createFileRoute } from '@tanstack/react-router'
+import { addToCart, getCartSummary, removeFromCart } from '~/data/db'
+
+export const Route = createFileRoute('/api/cart')({
+  server: {
+    handlers: {
+      GET: async () => Response.json(getCartSummary()),
+      POST: async ({ request }) => {
+        const body = await request.json()
+        return Response.json(addToCart(Number(body.promptId)))
+      },
+      DELETE: async ({ request }) => {
+        const url = new URL(request.url)
+        return Response.json(removeFromCart(Number(url.searchParams.get('promptId'))))
+      },
+    },
+  },
+})
*** End Patch
